extract: Stephen Allen Womack is an American politician serving as the U.S. representative for Arkansas's 3rd congressional district since 2011. The district covers much of northwestern Arkansas, including Fort Smith, Fayetteville, Springdale, and Womack's hometown of Rogers. Before he was elected to Congress, Womack was mayor of Rogers. He is a member of the Republican Party.
